scope: Batch 038 commuter experience changes; no browser, PostgreSQL, graph, or field operation was performed.

baseline_evidence.evidence_scope: Carried forward from Batch 037; hashes and corpus were not recomputed in Batch 038.

readiness.name: offline_graph_artifact_integrity
readiness.evidence: The verified graph SHA256 and counts are carried forward from earlier evidence; the immutable graph file was not modified or revalidated in Batch 038.

readiness.name: journey_discovery
readiness.evidence: Batch 037 origin-first search, debounce, cancellation, keyboard navigation, clear, swap, and retry remain in place; no separate search implementation was added.

readiness.name: result_presentation_and_explanations
readiness.evidence: A presentation helper separates planner ranking reasons from route structure, recorded walking geometry, direction, fare availability, stale records, and limitations. It reads existing journey fields only.

readiness.name: walking_and_map_evidence
readiness.evidence: Existing map geometry rules remain; estimate-only and missing geometry are not converted to walking lines. Separate SQLite graph live integration remains unproven.

readiness.name: map_and_list_coordination
readiness.evidence: Selected-journey and instruction-to-map synchronization are reused; no MapLibre browser interaction was exercised.

readiness.name: route_comparison_and_failure_states
readiness.evidence: Existing filters, explicit unavailable reasons, and empty/error states remain unchanged; no live API request was made.

readiness.name: ride_mode_progress
readiness.evidence: Added a previous-step correction for supported manual transitions and requires a walking step before boarding-area confirmation. No live vehicle or location verification is claimed.

readiness.name: saved_journeys_and_offline
readiness.evidence: Versioned local snapshots remain readable offline and retain cached-result labeling. Fresh planning still requires the API; graph routing is not declared generally offline.

readiness.name: can_i_ride
readiness.evidence: Existing API yes/no/unknown presentation is preserved; no second routing engine was added.

readiness.name: validation_ledger
readiness.evidence: Local atomic JSON ledger binds results to source/config/tool fingerprints. Blocked and failed records are not reusable passes.

readiness.name: mobile_and_accessibility
readiness.evidence: Native details disclosure has a minimum 44px summary target. No viewport or screen-reader browser test ran.

readiness.name: resource_guard

readiness.name: real_postgresql_staging

readiness.name: field_verification
readiness.evidence: Neither graph connectivity nor this UI work verifies transfer safety, boarding location, pedestrian conditions, or actual travel.

readiness.name: private_beta
readiness.evidence: Browser interaction, real staging/parity, and field verification remain open.
